## Description

Please include a summary of the change, relevant motivation, and context.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactor / Performance improvement

## Testing

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Include instructions and commands to reproduce.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`pytest` / `npm test`)
- [ ] Lint passes (`ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `npm run lint`)
- [ ] Documentation updated (`docs/`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` if applicable)
- [ ] No secrets included
- [ ] Breaking changes documented
